readerCopy.body: What you need now may be different from what has always made you feel safe. When the Moon opposes the South Node, a current emotional need can expose the limits of an old family pattern, coping strategy, or source of reassurance. You may realize that keeping everyone calm, going home, staying quiet, or reaching for the usual person no longer gives you what it used to. The old comfort may still be real. It just does not get to define the only way you can care for yourself.
